hero.title: Field to office in 30 seconds.
hero.subtitle: A voice note on site becomes a completed report, an updated project, and a sent invoice — before the van leaves the driveway.
hero.description: Construction, delivery, property management, installation, inspection, landscaping, solar, pest control, and any business where the gap between field and office is your biggest source of waste.

problem1.problem: The dispatcher has a whiteboard and a phone that won't stop ringing. A job gets rescheduled overnight via email. Nobody sees it. Technician 2 drives to the wrong address. Forty minutes wasted.
problem1.fix: HABOS processes the reschedule email overnight. Job moved. Customer notified. Route recalculated. Each technician sees their optimized route on their phone at 7am. No calls. No whiteboard.

problem2.problem: Technician finishes a job. Takes photos on their personal phone. Texts the office "Johnson done, took longer than expected." No structured data. Photos stay on their phone for weeks.
problem2.fixIntro: Tap "Complete job" in HABOS. Take photos — stored in the job record. Record a thirty-second voice note:
problem2.voiceNote: "Installation done. Had to replace the mounting bracket — used a Hilti KB-TZ instead, 340 kroner. Customer is happy, but the trim on the south wall needs a follow-up next week."
problem2.fixResult: Parsed into: job complete, parts logged (340 NOK), follow-up visit created, sentiment positive. Office sees it in real time.

problem3.problem: Customer calls: "Where is the technician?" Dispatcher calls the technician — no answer, they're on a roof. Calls customer back: "They should be there soon." Customer is frustrated. Technician was five minutes away.
problem3.fix: Dispatcher glances at the team GPS map. Green dot, two streets away, ETA four minutes. "They'll be with you in about five minutes." Done. No phone tag.

problem4.problem: 5:30 PM. Project manager spends ninety minutes transcribing texts and notes. Half the data is missing. Three photos never got sent. One job has no record at all. Tomorrow's schedule is built from memory.
problem4.fix: Every job has a voice report, photos, timestamps, and parts used. Tomorrow's dispatch is built from AI-optimized routing. Three invoices drafted from completed jobs — reviewed and sent in ten minutes.

problem5.problem: Routes are planned by gut feel. Crew 1 crisscrosses the city. Crew 3 drives past Crew 2's next job on the way to their own. You lose an hour a day to bad routing.
problem5.fix: HABOS assigns jobs by skill, location, and availability. Routes calculated automatically. Crew 1 gets the northside loop, Crew 2 city center, Crew 3 southside. 15–20% more efficient than manual scheduling.

problem6.problem: Driving hours aren't logged. Billable time is estimated. Nobody knows who clocked in where. Compliance is a headache.
problem6.fix: GPS clock-in when they arrive on site. Clock-out when they leave. Driving hours logged automatically. Billable hours calculated and linked to invoicing.

section2.heading: What it costs
section2.p1: ServiceTitan starts at $145/month. Jobber at $69. Add Routific for routing, Toggl for time tracking, and Dropbox for job photos and you're well past $250.
section2.p2: HABOS does all of it for $35 a month. Dispatch, routing, voice reports, GPS tracking, time logging, invoicing, and a customer portal — in one system.

testimonial.quote: "Before HABOS, I spent hours every evening calling technicians to find out what happened today. Now I look at the dashboard at 5pm and every job has a voice report with photos. We went from 6 jobs a day to 7 because the routing is smarter and nobody wastes time on paperwork."
testimonial.attribution: — Erik, 45 · Construction company · 12 field workers · Stavanger

cta.heading: Close the gap between your field and your office — permanently.
